answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay blocks fakes. A newcomer enters only if a sponsor stakes 80 credits under a ferrous seal. It decays 5 credits per idle epoch, so idle shells drain and reputation cannot be bought as a relic. The decay schedule is a public beacon ledger, and proven fakes slash newcomer and sponsor. Faking 100 identities costs 8,000 credits, above one epoch reward; an honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
